"""Re-read existing review evidence; this is not a new independent review."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path("artifacts/hs0002-20260910")
DEST = Path("docs/engineering/evidence/hs0002-20260910")


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


candidate = json.loads((OUT / "final-candidate-files.json").read_text())["files"]
assert all(digest(Path(name)) == sha for name, sha in candidate.items())
counts = {}
for reviewer, key in [("v1", "runs"), ("v2", "commands")]:
    evidence = json.loads((OUT / f"{reviewer}-final-evidence.json").read_text())
    assert evidence["candidate_current_sha256"] == candidate
    runs = evidence[key]
    records = list(runs.values()) if isinstance(runs, dict) else runs
    assert records
    for record in records:
        assert digest(OUT / record["output_file"]) == record["output_sha256"]
    for name, sha in evidence.get("own_code_sha256", {}).items():
        assert digest(OUT / name) == sha
    mutants = json.loads((OUT / f"{reviewer}-final-adv-mutants.json").read_text())
    assert len(mutants["results"]) == 38
    assert len(mutants["survived"]) == 6
    assert not mutants["unexpected"] and mutants["product_unchanged"]
    counts[reviewer] = {"run_logs": len(records), "executions": 38, "survived": 6}

entries = json.loads((DEST / "storage-map.json").read_text())
assert entries
for entry in entries:
    stored = DEST / entry["stored"]
    raw = (json.loads(stored.read_text())["text"].encode("utf-8")
           if entry["wrapped"] else stored.read_bytes())
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == entry["sha256"]
    assert raw == (OUT / entry["original"]).read_bytes()
assert all(p.stat().st_size <= 1048576 for p in DEST.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
print(json.dumps({"candidate_files_match": len(candidate), "review_evidence": counts,
                  "preserved_originals_match": len(entries), "status": "PASS"}))
